name: FanX
blurb: Salt Lake City's comic and pop culture convention at the Salt Palace, formerly Salt Lake Comic Con.

editions.evidence: Wayback Machine snapshot of the homepage, 2026-10-04 (the live site returns HTTP 403 to automated tools): 'FanX Salt Lake Comic & Pop Culture Convention March 11-13, 2027 Salt Palace Convention Center'

Salt Lake Tribune, 2026-06-04 ('Utah's FanX will move because Salt Palace is slated to be closed for 3 years'): FanX runs two 2027 conventions at the Salt Palace, in March and September, with the September show being 'the last one held at the Salt Palace for a few years' per founder Dan Farr; exact September days are not public yet.

notes: fanxsaltlake.com returned HTTP 403 on every attempt (default Chromium, --channel msedge, --fresh with an 8s wait, and WebFetch) -- a Cloudflare bot wall blocking the whole domain, not a content problem. Dates/venue/cover for the March edition come from a Wayback Machine snapshot of the real homepage instead; the cover key resolves to that snapshot's archive.org-proxied logo image since a direct fanxsaltlake.com asset URL could not be verified reachable from here. The archived page itself says 'The Event & Panel Programming Schedule is not live yet', so guests are 'none-yet' on both editions. Two editions in one city under one brand because the Salt Palace's multi-year renovation forced FanX to split its usual single show into separate March and September 2027 events; FanX moves to Sandy, UT starting 2028 per the same article.
